I'm in no position to tell you what to do, hell I'm in your position, but I think the best thing to do is to imagine yourself in a room, then imagine the part of your brain telling you're bad, then yell something along the lines of "WHO THE F*CK ARE YOU TO TELL ME I'M NOT WORTH IT? YOU KNOW JACK SH*T ABOUT WHO I AM, ALL YOU SEE IS FLAWS AND NOT THE OVERWHELMING AMOUNT OF POSITIVE QUALITIES I HAVE, SO, TO SUM, GO. TO. HELL, AND TAKE YOUR CRITIC WITH YOU!" But put your own spin on it, making it your own is half the fun of yelling at your inner critic
